sn35.111:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Sotaṃ || Ghānam || Jivhaṃ || Kāyam || Manam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Cakkhuñ ca kho bhikkhave abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayam pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Sotaṃ || Ghānaṃ || Jivhaṃ || Kāyam || Manam abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti || ||
